name: Add `rowbly skills install`
description:
Users that use rowbly have two options for skills:

- Import pre-built skills
- Create their own skills


I want a command that allows users to import pre-built skills for rowbly into their project. For this I want to introduce one command and update an existing:

- `rowbly skills install`: Installs a new skill, can either be run with <path_to_skill> OR when run by itself it will show a menu of skills available for install. Clack prompts should be used for menu
- `rowbly skills list`: Update this command to list out two sections: official skills and custom skills
